quote: Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill (CPMG) pulse sequence applies N equally spaced π pulses within an otherwise free-evolution time τ.
This concept extends to larger numbers N of π pulses, and is called a Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill (CPMG) sequence.

The more advanced versions, such as the CPMG-sequence, use multiple π-pulses to interrupt the system more frequently, pushing the filter band to even higher frequencies – a technique known as dynamical decoupling.
